overall: The AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing the Executive Director search, candidate withdrawal, and salary range in executive session under Purpose 2 on Nov 25 and Dec 4, 2024, and ordered compliance, minutes release, and training review.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission went into executive session on Nov 25 and Dec 4 to improperly select a new finalist for the Executive Director position.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Release the November 25 and December 4, 2024 executive session minutes to the public, without redacting any portion related to the Executive Director position.
Review the Attorney General's training video number 4 on executive sessions and the Public Body Checklist on executive sessions.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
